title: A deep learning model for CT-based kidney volume determination in dogs and normal reference definition.
summary: deep-learning CT segmentation/volume calculation on dogs, with groups by sex/neuter status; reference volumes and volume/bodyweight indices reported, no significant group differences for normalized indices. This supplies a veterinary imaging measurement/reference dataset, not evidence of disease causation.
ai_technology: AI volumetry supports a concrete normal canine kidney-volume reference result; retrospective sample and imaging protocol limit generalization.
